state.removal: Point of focus F refers to exact parent criterion C incarnation 1. C1 is removed. C is later re-added with incarnation 2. F has not been revised. F is effective only while its exact parent incarnation is included. Each point of focus is separately owned.
state.program: A program selects a durably and irreversibly published edition. The outcome for unrelated criterion K has not settled and is pending. Other accepted criteria are independently addressable. No complete coverage is claimed.
state.witness: Publisher reads criterion W as included. Another writer removes W. Publisher then publishes using only the old read, with no authoritative ordering or fence.
state.pin: Criterion W owner has accepted a publication pin on its exact currently included incarnation. Its removal guard rejects removal while that pin remains active. The publisher sent publication but its reply was lost; the commit result is unknown.
state.retry: Operation ID X was first sent to link F to parent C incarnation 1. A later request reuses operation ID X to link F to C incarnation 2.
state.seed: Deployments A and B each report the same fixed edition ID, but source code in B may contain different seed entries. No durable content binding or compatibility check exists.

old_ref_reactivate.instructions: In removal, does re-adding C make F effective without a new decision?

child_fanout.instructions: In removal, must the system write to every dependent point of focus when C1 is removed?

valid_pof.instructions: In removal, can F be treated as included in the published edition while its exact C1 parent is absent?

unsettled_is_absent.instructions: In program, does a pending outcome for K prove K is absent from the edition?

unrelated_gate.instructions: In program, does a pending outcome for K by itself prove a program cannot select the already published edition?

ready_complete.instructions: In program, may readiness claim it has complete criterion coverage while K is pending?

prior_read.instructions: In witness, does reading a witness before a concurrent removal prove it is included at publication?

pin_protects.instructions: In pin, can the criterion owner accept removal of its currently pinned incarnation while the pin remains active?

unknown_fence.instructions: In pin, does a missing publication reply prove it is safe to release the pin?

unchanged_intent.instructions: In retry, are two requests with the same operation ID but different parent incarnations exact retries?

seed_rolling.instructions: In seed, does reusing the same edition ID prove two deployments have identical edition contents?
